notes.title: New Features
items: Focus Mode (⌘.): hides the sidebars, toolbar, and status bar so the editor fills the window
Markdown with a maximum width now has matching top padding

notes.title: Bug Fixes
items: Toggling Focus Mode no longer scrolls markdown upward or stalls on long files

notes.title: New Features
items: Markdown now supports syntax highlighting, a clickable heading outline in the right sidebar, formatting toolbar buttons, and independent font and theme settings

notes.title: New Features
items: Markdown syntax highlighting
Clickable heading outline in the right sidebar
Bold / Italic / Strikethrough / Inline Code toolbar buttons for markdown
Editor settings: independent font, size, line spacing, and theme for editor and markdown, plus markdown max width
Over-scroll past the last markdown line

notes.title: Bug Fixes
items: Reloading a file no longer leaves a stale dirty indicator

notes.title: New Features
items: Files open as previews: a single click reuses the current preview tab; a double-click or an edit keeps the file open
Pin and unpin file tabs from the context menu or the hover button — only pinned tabs are restored when you relaunch
Split-pane tabs show every pane's icon in the sidebar row; the focused pane is underlined, and clicking an icon focuses it

notes.title: Bug Fixes
items: The current-line highlight in the editor gutter no longer covers two rows when the caret sits at the end of a file
Typing past the last line of a file no longer snaps the scroll — the document's bottom stays where it is instead of jumping to the window

notes.title: New Features
items: Transparent images show a checkerboard background in the image viewer, so their transparent areas are visible

notes.title: Bug Fixes
items: Text editor opens more file types: files the system labels non-text — like TypeScript and certificate files — and extensionless shebang scripts now open as text; binary property lists open as editable text and save back in their original format
Find and replace in the text editor works reliably
Opening a file that is already open in another split no longer splits the wrong pane — it opens a clean new tab

notes.title: New Features
items: Progress bar while the app downloads an update

notes.title: Bug Fixes
items: Failed update checks retry automatically

notes.title: New Features
items: Line numbers in the file editor, highlighting the current line
Scroll past the last line of a file, so the bottom of the document can sit in the middle of the window
Word count in the editor status bar

notes.title: Bug Fixes
items: Windows (CRLF) files keep their line endings when you edit them — they no longer show every line as changed in git

notes.title: New Features
items: File editor matches your terminal: the editor takes its colors from the selected terminal theme, so editing sits flush with the terminal beside it — toggle in Settings

notes.title: Bug Fixes
items: Caret no longer hangs below its line — it is now centered in the text editor
Fixed a text editor drawing bug with line spacing

notes.title: New Features
items: In-app updates: install a new version and relaunch right from the update window, with no manual download

notes.title: New Features
items: ? file lookup in the command palette: fuzzy-open any file in the working folder, reveal a directory in the Files panel, or start a session there

notes.title: New Features
items: Ghostty-powered terminal with hierarchical sidebar
Lightweight
Native macOS app
Zero config — works right out of the box
